method.missing: Description keys absent, null, empty, or whitespace-only. Any nonempty description language counts as present.
method.missing_turkish_only: Has another description but no nonempty description_tr; missing_turkish includes missing_all.
method.identifier_match_candidate: Case and punctuation insensitive exact identifier/physical-name match. This is a review candidate, not proof of missing semantics (VAT is a valid abbreviation).
method.generic_placeholder: Exact normalized match against explicit generic vocabulary; Internal Usage / Not In Use report status, not a business definition.
method.only_identifier_or_generic: All populated description fields match identifier/generic rules; no other description remains.
method.overlap: Quality flags may overlap missing_turkish_only. Do not add category totals. Source fields are recorded metadata, not verified provenance.
